_comment: Tier 1 + Tier 2 audit modules. Tier 1: PHI redaction, query path, export formats — security/correctness critical. Tier 2: workflow runtime, recovery sweep, durable journal — replay correctness. Tier 3: model helpers — pure logic shared by workers (streaming fetch) and the advisory voice-quality score (sub-score math). Advisory metric expected at ~70% kill rate; see src/models/voiceQuality.test.ts for the accepted-survivor categories.
